create_optimizer: create an optimizer from args and model with configurable learning rate, weight decay, and optimizer type
get_parameter_groups: get parameter groups from a model separated by weight decay and layer for fine-grained optimization
get_num_layer_for_vit: get the transformer layer index for a given parameter name in a ViT model
build_layer_decay_assigner: build a LayerDecayValueAssigner to assign per-layer learning rate scales for ViT parameter groups
review_create_optimizer: review the create_optimizer function that supports SGD, Adam, AdamW, and many timm optimizers with lookahead wrapping
